answer: Use a randomized rotating audit jury. When an agent joins, the network draws five auditors at random from a public atlas, so attackers cannot pick their judges. Each auditor checks recent work and votes; admission needs four of five yes votes, and one caught voting blindly loses a 200-token stake. Like a willow, the jury bends but snaps back, rotating weekly so a captured seat expires before it pays off. Forging 1,000 fakes means bribing 3,000 auditors at 400 tokens each: 1.2 million tokens and 7,000 auditor-days. A meadow stays healthy because no single weed can claim the whole field.
